title: Upper Deck Seat Track Section — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one upper deck seat track section between two splice positions, with the seats, the monuments and the floor panels already out of the bay, for replacement or for access to the floor beam flange.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of a single seat track section of the upper deck floor between two splice positions. Use it before a track section replacement or before an inspection of the floor beam upper flange below it.
sections.job_setup_note: Make sure that the seats and the cabin monuments are removed from the bay and that the floor panels are lifted and stored on edge. Put protective covers on the exposed structure. Make sure that the area below the bay is clear, because fasteners fall through the beam webs. Get the drill jig and the fastener removal set before you start, because the track cannot be left part-released overnight.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT WALK ON AN EXPOSED FLOOR BEAM. USE THE WORK PLATFORM AND THE HARNESS ATTACHMENT POINTS GIVEN IN THE JOB SET-UP. Put the work platform in position across the bay. Remove the seat track cover at each end of the section. Identify the two splice positions that bound the section and put a tag on each. Remove the clevis pins LN666073-13 at the two splice positions and keep them for the installation. Remove the fasteners along the track section, working from the centre outwards in the sequence given in the illustration. CAUTION: DO NOT LEVER AGAINST THE FLOOR BEAM UPPER FLANGE WHEN YOU LIFT THE TRACK. DAMAGE TO THE FLANGE IS NOT PERMITTED AND WILL MAKE A REPAIR NECESSARY. Lift the track section clear with two persons and put it on the storage rack. Remove the lower web sub-assembly D5350129109541 if it is fitted, and discard it. Remove the sealant and the loose protective compound from the beam flange with the approved solvent. Do a general visual inspection of the beam flange and record any corrosion or damage. Put a temporary cover over the open bay.
sections.close_out: Put the removed track section on the storage rack with the tags in place, so that the splice positions can be identified at installation. Keep the clevis pins in a labelled container. Make an entry in the aircraft technical log that the bay is open, and record the findings from the beam flange inspection before you close the task.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft post the sealed track section standard, the lower web sub-assembly is not fitted.

safety_precautions: Put the work platform across the floor beams before you go into the bay.
Make sure that the area below the bay is clear of personnel.
Put protective covers on the exposed structure.
